user.title: Set up Energy Engine
user.description: Point to the existing entities that report your grid import and export energy. This is the single, shared Energy Profile used by every Scenario you add afterwards.

add_scenario.title: Add a Scenario
add_scenario.description: A Scenario prices the shared Energy Profile against one Tariff Provider. Point to the existing entities that report its import rate, export rate, and standing charge.

error.name_exists: A Scenario with this name already exists.

run_scenario.name: Run Scenario
run_scenario.description: Prices the shared Energy Profile against one Scenario's Tariff Provider over a chosen lookback period.

period.name: Lookback period
period.description: How far back to price, ending now.

run_comparison.name: Run Comparison
run_comparison.description: Targets multiple Scenarios at once and prices each over the same chosen lookback period - an ad hoc Comparison.

period.name: Lookback period
period.description: How far back to price, ending now.

verify_entities.name: Verify Entities
verify_entities.description: Checks every entity the Data Source and Scenarios rely on for a chosen lookback period, without running a Simulation - reports which ones are missing statistics entirely, which have gaps, and which are fine.

period.name: Lookback period
period.description: How far back to check, ending now.
